ctx.x: -- it's for the -- it's for the, like -- like -- like Redd Foxx said, "It's for God and three other white men." You know. [laughter] You know. So, like, you know what I'm saying? So that, but -- but I was the only -- I was -- the whole band was Caucasian with a couple of Mexican gentlemen and I was the only Negro in there. And they had females in there, you know, playing strings along with the guys and everybody was -- everybody was wonderful.
